subject: Hightide SIG intake: scheduling, evidence deck plan and logs export
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@hightide.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake + scheduling

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the intro last week. We want to start the SIG/CAIQ intake for Hightide's procurement team. Two asks to get the kickoff scheduled:

1) A 45-minute intake call next week to walk through the questionnaire scope and owners.
2) A short list of artifacts you typically need up-front (logs, configuration docs, encryption key custody docs).

Our initial availability: Tue 6/15 10–12 PT or Thu 6/17 13–16 PT.

If helpful, I can share our completed CAIQ partial answers in advance — attaching a one-page question list for prioritization.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Security Program Manager
Hightide Analytics
attachments: sig_question_list.pdf (application/pdf, 78 KB)

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.in>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@hightide.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.in>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake + scheduling

Alex — thanks, and great to meet you.

We can do a 45-minute intake. Tue 6/15 10:30–11:15 PT works for our team — proposing that slot and sending a calendar hold.

Up-front artifacts that help us triage and scope the SIG:
- Evidence matrix (service owner, artifact type, contact) — we can provide a template.
- Recent log export sample (1 day, redacted) and log retention policy.
- Architecture diagram that shows where customer data enters the system.
- KMS/HSM configuration summary (key management, rotation cadence).
- Any vendor contracts that include data residency clauses.

We typically ask customers to drop those artifacts in a shared Drive folder before the call. I attached a brief export_instructions.txt that explains the log sample format we prefer — small plain text/CSV exports are easiest.

Marissa will lead evidence collection; Ben will join the intake to confirm logging/retention questions.

See calendar invite (will send separately). If the proposed slot doesn't work, tell us which of your windows is best.

Best,
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: export_instructions.txt (text/plain, 2 KB)

To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.in>

Thanks Priyom — Tuesday 6/15 10:30 PT works for Alex and me. Calendar invite accepted.

We've dropped a first-pass evidence bundle into the Drive folder you shared and attached the one-page question list Alex mentioned. The bundle includes:
- hightide_evidence_matrix.xlsx (owners + links to artifacts)
- network-arch-v1.png (diagram) — link inside the matrix
- limited log export (redacted_logs_20270601.csv) — note: sample is redacted for PII

2) Are you able to provide an example of the log retention policy text you require for SOC 2 evidence?

If you need anything else before the 15th we can upload it to the same folder.

Cheers,
Maya Singh

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.in>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@hightide.io>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@hightide.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.in>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.in>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake + scheduling — notes & pre-call requests

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the uploads — looks good from our first pass. A few pre-call items so we can use the 45 minutes efficiently:

- KMS: a screen-grab of your KMS policy page is fine for the intake; we'll request exported config only if we hit a gap.
- Retention: we will paste a short example retention clause during the call and flag which artifacts we need for SOC 2 evidence. Generally we look for retention windows (days/weeks/months), deletion procedure, and any archival controls.
- Please ensure the redacted_logs_20270601.csv includes at least one request/response trace (headers + timestamps) so we can validate log shapes.

Agenda for 6/15 (45 mins):
1) Introductions & roles (5 min)
2) Scope alignment: SIG vs CAIQ coverage (10 min)
3) Evidence walkthrough: matrix & artifacts (15 min)
4) Log sample assessment & retention questions (10 min)
5) Next steps & owners (5 min)

Action items before the call:
- Hightide: ensure the evidence matrix links open for external sharing and that the log sample includes a single request trace.
- Redwood: we will provide an evidence matrix template and a short sample SOC2 retention clause (attached).

I've attached a concise sample retention clause and our evidence-template link to the folder. If anything changes on timing let us know. Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: sample_retention_clause.txt (text/plain, 1 KB), evidence_template_link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Hgt-hightide-sig
